lines.text: Buckets! Put that on the fridge.
Still got it. Never lost it, sweetie.
That's how we did it in nineteen fifty-eight!
Count it! And count my pills while you're at it.
Who moved the hoop? Somebody moved the hoop.
My glasses were foggy. That one doesn't count.
Did you hear that? That's the sound of class.
In and out? Now that is just mean.
Spit it back, will you? How dare you.
So close! I'll write a letter to the rim.
Loose ball! Out of my way!
I'm coming, and I'm not happy.
Mine! Back to the kitchen with you.
Still faster than the mail man.
Just checking the floor. It's still there.
Up we go. Grandma doesn't quit.
Level up! Somebody call the newspaper.
New trick unlocked. Eat your heart out.
Where's my competition? Scared, I bet.
Back in my day, the ball was heavier.
I should have brought a sweater.
Too quick for you? Bless your heart.
